# CT Signal

> CT Signal is an automated newsroom for Connecticut: the news cycle picks the
> question, public data answers it. Every number is fetched from a named public
> dataset (Data Commons, data.ct.gov) — never written by a language model.
> Published every 15 minutes as static, citable story pages with the query
> attached.

## Pages

- [The board](https://ctsignal.org/): current Connecticut rankings among the 52 U.S. peers (50 states, DC, Puerto Rico).
- [Latest questions](https://ctsignal.org/#signals): the rolling feed of answered news questions.
- [RSS](https://ctsignal.org/feed.xml) / [JSON Feed](https://ctsignal.org/feed.json)
- [About](https://ctsignal.org/about), [Methodology](https://ctsignal.org/methodology), [Masthead](https://ctsignal.org/masthead), [Corrections](https://ctsignal.org/corrections)

## Notes

- Story permalinks: https://ctsignal.org/story/<id> — republication is free with attribution and a link.
- Data honesty rules: ranks use all 52 peers and are phrased direction-honestly; every card prints its data vintage.
